useTabs.description: Whether to use tabs (true) or spaces (false).

newLineKind.description: The kind of newline to use.

oneOf.description: For each file, uses the newline kind found at the end of the last line.
Uses the system standard (ex. crlf on Windows).

lineWidth.description: The width of a line the printer will try to stay under. Note that the printer may exceed this width in certain cases.

indentWidth.description: The number of characters for an indent.

dialect.description: The SQL dialect the files are written in, which decides how the text is split into tokens: which characters start a comment or quote an identifier, whether a backslash escapes a quote, and so on. The generic dialect accepts the syntax of all of the others where they don't conflict.

oneOf.description: The syntax of all of the dialects where they don't conflict.
PostgreSQL, which also suits databases that use its syntax (ex. CockroachDB, DuckDB and Redshift).
Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL (T-SQL).

casing.description: The casing of keywords. Names (ex. of tables and columns) and functions are left as written.

uppercase.description: Deprecated. Use 'casing' instead. Use ALL CAPS for keywords.

linesBetweenQueries.description: The minimum number of line breaks between statements at the top level of the file. A blank line between statements is kept regardless.

joinsAsTopLevel.description: Whether to write joins at the indentation of the FROM keyword rather than indented beneath it.
